name: QRFolders Lite – QR Code Folders for Google Drive
author: qrfolders

sections.description:
QRFolders Lite allows you to link a QR code to a document folder stored in Google Drive and present its contents on a clean, public-facing page. When the QR code is scanned, users are shown the current files in that folder, ensuring they always access the most up-to-date information at the point of use.

Folder contents can be updated at any time in Google Drive without changing or reissuing the QR code. This makes QRFolders Lite suitable for situations where QR codes are printed on stickers, labels, handouts, or embedded within PDF documents, whether those PDFs are automatically generated by the plugin or created separately by the user.

The QR code remains permanently linked to the folder identity, meaning printed QR codes continue to work even as documents are added, removed, or replaced.

Typical use cases include:
– Equipment manuals and safety documents
– Hire and rental documentation
– Property or facilities information
– Internal staff documentation
– Customer handouts

QRFolders Lite focuses on stability and simplicity. Printed QR codes remain valid even when folder contents change.

Features

  • Create folders linked to Google Drive
  • Generate permanent QR codes for each folder
  • Display folder contents on a clean public page
  • Download QR codes for printing or sharing
  • Auto Generate PDF’s with your own text, showing the QR code
  • QR downloads use readable filenames based on folder names
  • Folder updates do not require QR reprinting

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality.

Google Drive

QRFolders Lite connects to the Google Drive API to display folder contents.

Data sent:
– Folder identifiers required to retrieve file listings

When data is sent:
– When a folder is viewed on the public-facing QR page
– When folder contents are refreshed

Service provider:
Google LLC

Terms of Service:
https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

QR Image Generation

QRFolders Lite generates QR code images using an external QR image generation service.

Data sent:
– The public QR URL associated with the folder

When data is sent:
– When a QR image is generated for the first time

Service provider:
QRServer (api.qrserver.com)

Privacy Policy:
https://goqr.me/api/doc/privacy/

Terms of Service:
https://goqr.me/api/doc/terms/

Generated QR images are cached locally on the site after creation.
